scientific_integrity: The finite classification is exact rational arithmetic with an independently computed Gram rank. The infinite range is established analytically. No independent verification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed fourteen-node sphere only; unweighted pure-degree sampling, not a general quadrature theorem; infinite tail depends on the classical Bernstein inequality; original-source and indexing coverage bounded.
title: Exact all-degree harmonic interpolation on the fourteen-node Lebedev sphere
